ships.name: Scarlet Lady
ships.notes: Delivered 14 February 2020. First US sailing 6 October 2021. 1,290 cabins and 102 RockStar Quarters. Guests = max Sailors, a fleet-wide figure from the line's media fact sheet, not a per-ship published capacity.

ships.name: Valiant Lady
ships.notes: First voyage from Barcelona 15 May 2022. 1,330 cabins and 78 RockStar Quarters. Sails from PortMiami. Guests = fleet-wide max Sailors figure.

ships.name: Resilient Lady
ships.notes: Launched 14 May 2023 from Athens. 1,330 cabins and 78 RockStar Quarters. Guests = fleet-wide max Sailors figure.

ships.name: Brilliant Lady
ships.notes: Debuted September 2025 from New York City. 1,330 cabins and 78 RockStar Quarters. Guests = fleet-wide max Sailors figure.

flag: Guest capacity is the fact sheet's fleet-wide 2,770 max Sailors, applied to all four because the line publishes it that way. It is not a per-ship published figure.
